calibration_summary: NVMe Base 1.4 specifies several host-side calibration / configuration loops: (1) Memory Page Size negotiation — CC.MPS must lie within [CAP.MPSMIN, CAP.MPSMAX]; (2) Number of Queues negotiation via Set Features FID 07h, where the controller returns the granted count which may be less than requested; (3) Maximum Data Transfer Size enforcement — host must split data commands larger than 2^MDTS × MPSMIN-page bytes; (4) Power State negotiation via Identify Controller PSD array and Set Features FID 02h; (5) Temperature Threshold configuration via Set Features FID 04h. All electrical-level calibration (PCIe transmitter equalization, lane training, deskew) is delegated to the underlying PCIe Base Spec and PHY IP.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Memory Page Size
host_negotiation_loops.purpose: Choose a CC.MPS value supported by both host and controller.
procedure: Pick a CC.MPS value in [MPSMIN, MPSMAX] that matches host MMU page size (commonly 0 for 4 KiB).

host_negotiation_loops.name: Number of I/O Queues
procedure: Set Features FID=07h with CDW11 = (NCQA-1)<<16 | (NSQA-1) (0's-based requested counts).
Host shall not Create I/O queues beyond the granted counts.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Max Data Transfer Size (MDTS)
procedure: Max bytes per command = 2^MDTS × (CC.MPS-derived page size).
If MDTS=0, no limit imposed by controller (transport may still impose limits).

host_negotiation_loops.name: Arbitration Burst
host_negotiation_loops.purpose: Tune burst depth per Submission Queue.
procedure: Read Identify Controller RAB (byte 72) — recommended arbitration burst.
Configure via Set Features FID=01h (Arbitration); CDW11 = HPW<<24 | MPW<<16 | LPW<<8 | AB.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Temperature Threshold
procedure: Set Features FID=04h; CDW11 = TMPSEL<<20 | THSEL<<16 | TMPTH (Kelvin).
Controller generates an Asynchronous Event when threshold crossed.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Power State Transition
host_negotiation_loops.purpose: Choose a Power State from Identify Controller PSD array.
procedure: Read Identify Controller PSDx (NPSS+1 entries; each gives Max Power, Active Power, Entry Latency, Exit Latency, Operational State).
Set Features FID=02h (Power Management); CDW11.PS = desired state.
Enable Autonomous Power State Transition via Set Features FID=0Ch if desired.

no_card_side_analog_trim: NVMe Base 1.4 exposes no analog trim / calibration register at the controller interface. Internal NAND/SCM media trim, ECC margin calibration, read-retry, and wear leveling are vendor-managed and not visible to host.
pcie_layer_calibration_delegated: PCIe transmitter equalization (Gen 3+), lane deskew, link training (LTSSM), and Equalization Phase 0..3 are governed by the PCI Express Base Specification, not by NVMe.

vdd_ramp_characterization.supply_specification: Determined by form factor — M.2 (3.3 V), U.2 (3.3 V + 12 V), EDSFF (12 V).
vdd_ramp_characterization.host_action_after_perst: Wait for PCIe link to establish (LTSSM L0); then issue PCI Configuration cycle; then proceed with NVMe controller bring-up.

notes: The Number-of-Queues negotiation is the most operationally important 'calibration' loop — the host requests an upper bound and the controller returns a possibly-smaller granted bound. The MDTS limit drives I/O scheduler splitting in OS NVMe drivers. The Memory Page Size selection is fixed at controller-enable time and cannot change without a Controller Reset.
